description: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!
name: Golf With Your Friends

objectives.co_op_rules: Play together. Multiply the stroke count in the primary objective by # of players, combined scores must be lower than the that number
objectives.versus_tertiary: Lowest score at end of course
